nodes.label: Explicit product settings confirmation
nodes.rationale: Six product columns at /packing/setup. Confirm settings explicitly accepts a prefilled estimate; save without confirmation leaves draft. Unknown EL needs explicit choice. Pack-size/net weight belongs to intake.

nodes.label: Temperature determines box material
nodes.rationale: Cold means Foam; Normal/Ambient means Cardboard. Temperature-only API edit sets material and contradictory pairs fail. Unknown temperature remains unresolved; confirmation does not create automatic weight exception.

nodes.label: 29 October product temperature review
nodes.rationale: Workbook283 rows:266 Cold/Foam,17 Normal/Cardboard. Normalized matching covers349 of818 catalogue products:332 Cold/Foam,17 Normal/Cardboard; other469 need review and defaults are unaccepted classifications.

nodes.label: Accepted product volume calculation
nodes.rationale: Occupied litres = order net kg times accepted product litres/kg; 1kg in ten100g packs at6L/kg uses6L. Historical aliases/draft profiles cannot override. Piece/bunch orders need usable weight.15 approved sizes,8% allowance; single-product limits only for single-product boxes; safe weight/volume apply all boxes.

nodes.label: Strict planning prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Strict planning remains off in preparation. Enabling requires resolved classifications,firmness,accepted litres/kg and reviewed boxes. With PACKING_PROFILES_ENABLED=false use accepted L/kg,else reviewed pack profile,else default_unit_volume_cm3. Draft estimates do not block workflow tests; locked snapshots never rewritten.

nodes.label: Workbook classification precedence
nodes.rationale: PRODUCT CODES.xlsx supplies official code,names,explicit EL; Norway list is not positionally joined. Grouping List supplies box,temperature,EL/combinable,light/heavy,capacity. Grouping marks override code EL; blanks unknown, contradictions unresolved,duplicate codes identity reviewed. Weight ranges use lower bound; no complete firmness/measured volume.

nodes.label: Product field provenance and revisions
nodes.rationale: Staff field corrections retained across imports; each save checks product revision and records audit. Bulk saves keep valid rows with individual errors; histories,aliases,prices,order links retained.

nodes.label: Product table safe rollout
nodes.rationale: Source builder then preview and inspect import JSON before --apply with expected project reference. Apply takes backup,migrates0015,verifies product/order/profile counts and locked-history hash; refuses while strict planning enabled. Initial818 products/3180 profiles preserved;230 estimates and332 box limits unaccepted;5 duplicate codes,497 unknown EL.
